entry.title: Opinion: Metroid II Doesn't Care If Samus Lives Or Dies
entry.summary: An existential crisis courtesy of the Game Boy. I recently started playing Metroid II: Return of Samus for the first time. I’m not sure why. Maybe it was a way of staving off my intense cravings for Metroid Prime 4: Beyond, which as of writing still doesn’t have a launch date more concrete than the vague '2025' window Nintendo revealed over a year ago. In any case, Metroid II impressed me almost immediately, but it wasn’t until I saw heroine Samus Aran die that I realised just how unique it is in relation to the rest of the series. While the video game industry places a lot of importance on the benefits of more powerful hardware, developers can also do incredible things when presented with limitations. Metroid II, released in North America in late 1991 before making its way to Japan and Europe the following year, is a great example of this phenomenon. The changes made to ensure the nascent Metroid formula was readable on the Game Boy’s small, colourless screen resulted in a handheld adventure still praised today for its austere atmosphere. entry.title: Madden 26 multiplayer guide – How to play Madden 26 with friends
entry.summary:
There are many ways you can play Madden 26's multiplayer modes, and it's a different type of fun when you're playing with your friends.
You can not only play against your friends in friendlies, but you can also be part of the same squad and play together. Let's find out what you need to do to play with your friends, and this option can be expanded further with crossplay.
How to play Madden 26 with your friends?
The easiest way to play with your friends in Madden 26 is the H2H mode.
Load up the game.
From the list of available modes, select Online H2H.
Pick Play a Friend. You can use this mode to play against strangers on the internet.
To select your friend, open the EA app overlay on PC. The overlay is available by default on consoles.
You'll find a list of all your available friends who are online. You can only send a match request to a friend who is currently online in Madden 26.
You can add your friend to the EA's friend list via their username/player ID.
Once you send the request, your friend will have to accept it to join the same lobby. You can change the default settings to enjoy more options. This includes fixing the game style in discussion with your friend. You can also change the quarter length, injuries, and more.
Screenshot by Destructoid
While all games happen with the default squad, you can use a custom squad with your friend. You can go with an alternate depth chart that is separate from the default list.
H2H friendlies are purely for bragging rights. There are no consequences of wins and losses, and no in-game rewards to obtain. However, it's fun and allows you to establish your virtual NFL supremacy in your friend circle.
It's always good to surprise your friends with some underrated tactics, and mastering the read option can be one such move. The ability to pull an unexpected move can trump even the most experienced players.

entry.title: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater won’t launch with its multiplayer mode, but should get it this fall
entry.summary:
MGS Delta: Snake Eater, the remake of Metal Gear Solid 3, is not going to launch with its planned multiplayer mode, Fox Hunt. This new online component will differ from previous iterations, such as Metal Gear Online, and should come within a few months after release.
Though Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater is still aiming to release worldwide and on all major platforms on Aug. 28, its online component, called Fox Hunt, will be put off for a few months. According to IGN, Konami did not specify when exactly Fox Hunt is to be added to MGS Delta, but said it'll be this Fall, i.e., between September and December.
MGS Delta is a remake of 2004's stellar tactical-espionage-action game MGS3. Screenshot via Konami YouTube
As opposed to previous online Metal Gear modes, such as Metal Gear Online that came with Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots, Fox Hunt is a unique and specially designed mode tied solely to this new Metal Gear title. As Yu Sahara, a long-time Metal Gear Solid developer, told IGN, Fox Hunt is “a completely original” mode with “completely different” gameplay to MGS Delta: Snake Eater.
He added that Fox Hunt will be focused on survival and stealth and be “more than just a shootout,” explaining the mode should take “camouflage and hide and go seek to the next level.”
Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater is a remake of the 2004 classic stealth-action game Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater, directed by the one and only Hideo Kojima. It aims to maintain the original's core design philosophy and stick as closely to it as possible while expanding mechanics and introducing waves of quality-of-life improvements, among other things.
It is slated for release on Aug. 28, though unfortunately without its multiplayer component.

entry.title: Are Madden 26 servers down? How to check server status
entry.summary:
If you've been trying to enjoy the early access of Madden 26 but can't do it properly, you're not alone.
The opening night of early access has been highly problematic for the servers. Numerous in-game issues and bugs have already appeared, particularly on the PC version. As a result, EA Sports has called in an emergency maintenance, which is already underway.
Table of contents Is Madden 26 down? How to check Madden 26 server status?
Is Madden 26 down?
As the time of writing this article, on Aug. 7, all the servers of Madden 26 are down. This applies to both the PC and console versions of the game. The servers have been taken down at 1pm PT/3pm CT/4pm ET. A short notice was handed out from the game's official X account, informing the audience.
According to the official world, the maintenance targets a specific issue. The issue in discussion hasn't been announced, but there are plenty of bugs to fix, and that might be one of the biggest reasons behind the maintenance. There's no official news about when the maintenance will end. The downtime could be long, depending on what the exact issue is and how long it could potentially take EA to fix it.
How to check Madden 26 server status?
Server connection is mandatory if you're looking to enjoy the game. Most of the available game modes require a persistent internet connection. The easiest way to keep track of the servers is via the official game's X channel. Typically, there will be an official notice whenever the servers are taken down for maintenance (like the one above).
Another great source is following the game's subreddit, which is an active community for all things Madden. If the servers are down, you'll find one or more posts from the community. Finally, there are third-party sites like Downdetector that will accurately indicate when the Madden servers are down and not operating as intended.

entry.title: Where to find Pack-a-Punch in BO6 Zombies Reckoning
entry.summary:
The final Black Ops 6 Zombies map is here, but before you finish the story, you'll need a weapon strong enough to keep you in the fight.
While the new Gorgofex Wonder Weapon is of interest to all Zombies gamers, the first thing you need to do in any Zombies map is locate the Pack-a-Punch machine to power up your guns so that you'll be able to mow down the hordes of the undead efficiently while trying to figure out the main story quest and all of its Easter Eggs along the way.
Here's how to find the Pack-a-Punch machine in BO6 Zombies Reckoning.
BO6 Zombies Reckoning Pack-a-Punch location
Screenshot by Destructoid
The Pack-a-Punch machine can be found in the T2 Sublevel 10 area, which is the room with a massive laser in the middle of it. To get there, follow the first few objective markers.
Get to Richtoften's office.
Buy the first few doors to navigate your way through the towers, using teleporters and launchers to make your way to Tower 1's Executive Suites level. Once you're there, interact with the item on Richtofen's desk to spawn a portal that will take you to T2 Sublevel 10.
Once in Sublevel 10, restart the Particle Accelerator by interacting with the marked icon, and the massive laser in the room will power on. Now, you must shoot 12 Aetherium deposits marked within the Coolant Pipes to fix your error and get to the next step.
Screenshot by Destructoid
Once complete, the Pack-a-Punch machine spawns in. It will be floating around in the middle of the room, and occasionally it will disappear for a second before teleporting close by in the area.
As usual, Pack-a-Punch costs 5,000 points to use, so make sure to kill enough zombies to get what you need to power up your weapon.

entry.title: Guntouchables multiplayer guide – How to play with friends
entry.summary:
Indie title Guntouchables is grabbing plenty of headlines with its unique offer (keep the game for free if you play in the first 24 hours), and it's the perfect title to enjoy with your friends.
Despite being in early access, the game offers both single and multiplayer content for players. There are different game modes available as well, offering a good variety to players. While you can matchmake with random players, there's a cool system to form a lobby with your friends. The underlying system is fairly simple, but this guide will help you avoid all confusion.
How to play Guntouchables with friends?
A lot of multiplayer titles force you to be friends with players to form lobbies. Guntouchables, on the other hand, uses simple code-based lobbies. Here's how you can play with your friends.
Load the game up and open multiplayer.
You'll find a host of public lobbies to join for your applicable region. Don't join any game.
At the bottom right corner, you'll find the option to create a lobby.
Your created lobby will have a code.
Copy the code, and disable your lobby from being public.
If your created lobby is public, any player on the same server can join.
Once your created lobby is private, share the code with your friends.
Screenshot by Destructoid
Here's what your friends then have to do to play in the same lobby.
Open and load the game.
Go to multiplayer.
On the top right side of your screen, you get the option to use a code to join a lobby.
If they use the code you sent, they will be added to your lobby.
Once all of you're part of the same code, select the type of game you want to play, and start playing together. Most of the game modes will be locked, but you can unlock them by just playing the game. If you want to test yourself solo, the singleplayer content is pretty fun (have been playing for sometime now, and the vibes kick in hard).

entry.title: Apex Legends' latest go at a compressed battle royale forgets the journeying spirit at the genre's heart
entry.summary: Apex Legends launched its Season 26 update this week with the new Wildcard mode, what must be its fourth or fifth attempt at a 'battle royale but faster' sideshow. If anything, Wildcard – with its tightened safe zones, generous respawn allowances and automatic loot pickups – is the most ferocious, cage fightin'est variant yet, its matches routinely playing out as breathless slaughters as crammed-in squads fight, die, and resurrect over a condensed selection of strongholds. Still, while I’ve enjoyed ApeLegs' previous action-favouring tweaks, something about Wildcard underwhelms. It’s not the shooting, which is as crisp and dynamic as in any other Respawn FPS. And it’s not the simplified gear gobbling, which is fine for a supplementary mode. It’s that at the end of a Wildcard round, even the ones I’ve won, I’ve never felt that I’ve really gone anywhere or done anything except aim down my sights and left-click. In chasing nonstop drama it denies you something that good battle royales, and their progenitors, can so effectively deliver: a journey. Read more

entry.title: Wheel World, let me build weirder bikes
entry.summary: I’ve been liking, even occasionally loving ghostly bicycle racer Wheel World, for several reasons. One, it’s relaxing enough for post-work decompression; two, it’s just competitive enough that I can enjoy winning without necessarily undermining point one; and three, it’s far enough outside my usual interests that the culture and lexicon it celebrates feel fresh and interesting to learn. entry.title: I was a fool for skipping Widelands, the only game as good as The Settlers
entry.summary:
Between fifty game releases a day, and among them official successors and open source remakes, most 90s games your grandma bangs on about have some modern equivalent that somewhat fills the gap.
But not The Settlers. There hasn't been a Settlers game since 1996. Whether they were good or not, its many sequels, as early as 3, started missing the point of the design. It's the roads, man. The roads!
This isn't about iconography for its own sake. It's a design thing, an ethos. The heart of The Settlers was that your towns lived or died based largely on how well you designed your transport logistics. It was all about the roads. It doesn't even fit into a genre really, let alone the lopsided RTS the sequels collapsed into. It sounds like a typical town builder, especially today when there's a wealth of games about placing a woodcutter and a farm, but I'm tempted to say it's not even about gathering resources.

entry.title: Nvidia GeForce RTX 5050 review: Starting, and finishing, at the bottom
entry.summary: There was a time when I’d be chuffed to bits to be clicking a new entry-level graphics card into its PCIe home. Think back to the GTX 1050 Ti or the Radeon RX 570 – these weren’t just great GPUs because they were accessible, but because you could practically feel the scrappiness bouncing off their circuitry. Like barking little chihuahuas, throwing down against a pack of mastiffs. You can see they’re no match for the bigger boys. But you kind of love them for not caring. The Nvidia GeForce RTX 5050 is no such card. It is the most affordable of the RTX 50 series, undercutting the RTX 5060 by about £40 / $50, and it does come with a full set of DLSS 4 tools including Multi Frame Generation (MFG) support. Its performance, sadly, leans more slow than scrappy, and it isn’t even really that cheap. Prices start around £220 / $250 and this overclocked Zotac model I’ve tested is £248 / $270, so it’s still going to be by far the priciest component in any budget PC build. Read more

entry.title: Ninja Gaiden: Ragebound review
entry.summary: In the realm of pixel artistry, action platformer Ninja Gaiden: Ragebound is a pretty work of dither and parallax. Between the more standard run 'n' chop levels, there are jetski chasedowns, motorcycle pursuits, cargo train battles, bulldozer escapes, and gas chamber breakouts. If it didn't frequently result in a death screen, I'd say it barely pauses for breath. The whole game is less a mineshaft of nostalgia as it is a shale fracking job, flushing you with jets of high pressure pseudomemory. Pak většina z toho zmizela (včetně té výpravy!) a zbytek filmu je zase totéž jako většina ostatních Marvel filmů: dvě-tři větší akce, trocha triviální filosofie o smyslu rodiny a přátelství, a na konci slib, že "v příštím pokračování to ale opravdu bude stát za to!" (Ilča 30 %)

entry.title: Zcela náhodný Christopher Guest
entry.summary:
Ne že bych jméno "Christopher Guest" vůbec neznal, ale až dnes mi došlo, že tyto tři velmi rozdílné role v mých oblíbených retrofilmech This is Spinal Tap, Princezna nevěsta a Pár správných chlapů hraje tentýž člověk.
Který, mimochodem, je skutečný nefalšovaný baron a má už 40 let za manželku Jamii Lee Curtisovou. Tomu říkám široký záběr. (Tento post nemá žádný skrytý hlubší smysl.)
